BackendAuto: BackendAuto lets goome pick the backend itself.
BackendGnome: BackendGnome is the GNOME Wayland backend.
BackendPortal: BackendPortal is the backend that grabs the screen through the desktop portal.
BackendTest: BackendTest is the headless test backend.
BackendOffscreen: BackendOffscreen is the offscreen backend, with no OS window.
ModeOverlay: ModeOverlay is the mode that draws a see-through layer over every monitor, where only hit rects take clicks.
ModeWindow: ModeWindow is the mode that opens one normal window.
ModeOffscreen: ModeOffscreen is the mode with no OS window, just a pixel buffer you read.
WindowResizable: WindowResizable lets the user resize the window.
WindowBorderless: WindowBorderless removes the OS title bar and border so you draw your own.
WindowTransparent: WindowTransparent turns the canvas alpha into real per pixel window alpha, so you can make shaped windows.
WindowOnTop: WindowOnTop keeps the window above other windows.
WindowHidden: WindowHidden starts the window hidden until you show it.
WindowCenter: WindowCenter centers the window on the screen when it opens.
WindowNoConsole: WindowNoConsole hides the console window on Windows. It is off by default.
OK: OK is the success return code, anything below it is an error.
CodeNotSupported: CodeNotSupported is the error code for something this backend cannot do.
CodeDenied: CodeDenied is the error code for a call that was not allowed, either by permissions or because the user said no.
CodeNoDisplay: CodeNoDisplay is the error code for having no display to draw on.
CodeGone: CodeGone is the error code for a monitor that is gone.
CodeAgain: CodeAgain is the error code for nothing being ready yet, so try again in a bit.
CodeNoMem: CodeNoMem is the error code for running out of memory.
CodeArg: CodeArg is the error code for a bad argument.
CapCapture: CapCapture means Capture works on this backend.
CapGlobalPointer: CapGlobalPointer means Pointer reports the mouse everywhere, not only over hit rects.
CapHideSelf: CapHideSelf means HideSelf really keeps the overlay out of screen grabs.
CapKeyboard: CapKeyboard means the keyboard can be taken from other apps.
CapWindow: CapWindow means window mode works here.
CapClipboard: CapClipboard means the clipboard functions reach the real system clipboard.
CapCursor: CapCursor means the cursor shape calls change the real cursor.
CapGrab: CapGrab means Grab gets a real pointer grab from the OS.
WantMouse: WantMouse is set when the pointer is over a hit rect, a press or drag is going, or a popup or modal is open, so the game should leave the mouse alone.
WantKeyboard: WantKeyboard is set when a widget has keyboard focus or a modal is open, so the game should leave the keyboard alone.
EventNone: EventNone is the event type for nothing happening.
EventDown: EventDown is the event for a mouse button press.
EventUp: EventUp is the event for a mouse button release.
EventMotion: EventMotion is the event for the pointer moving.
EventScroll: EventScroll is the event for the mouse wheel.
EventKey: EventKey is the event for a key press.
EventHotkey: EventHotkey is the event for a registered hotkey, with its ID in ID.
EventControl: EventControl is the event for a line sent through the control fifo, in Msg.
EventMonitors: EventMonitors is the event for the monitor list changing, so ask for it again.
EventQuit: EventQuit is the event for time to go, such as the session ending.
EventClose: EventClose is the event for the window close button, alt-f4 or cmd-w, and the app decides what to do.
EventFocus: EventFocus is the event for the window gaining or losing focus, with ID 1 for gained and 0 for lost.
EventDrop: EventDrop is the event for a file dropped on the window, with the path in Msg.
EventText: EventText is the event for an IME, dead key or compose finishing some text, with the text in Msg.
EventPreedit: EventPreedit is the event for the text being composed changing, with ID as the caret byte offset and an empty Msg when composing ends.
CursorArrow: CursorArrow is the normal arrow cursor.
CursorIBeam: CursorIBeam is the text insertion cursor.
CursorHand: CursorHand is the pointing hand cursor.
CursorResizeEW: CursorResizeEW is the left and right resize cursor.
CursorResizeNS: CursorResizeNS is the up and down resize cursor.
CursorResizeNWSE: CursorResizeNWSE is the diagonal resize cursor running from top left to bottom right.
CursorResizeNESW: CursorResizeNESW is the diagonal resize cursor running from top right to bottom left.
CursorNo: CursorNo is the not allowed cursor.
EdgeLeft: EdgeLeft is the left edge bit for WindowDrag resize requests.
EdgeRight: EdgeRight is the right edge bit for WindowDrag resize requests.
EdgeTop: EdgeTop is the top edge bit for WindowDrag resize requests.
EdgeBottom: EdgeBottom is the bottom edge bit for WindowDrag resize requests.
StateNormal: StateNormal is the normal window state.
StateMinimized: StateMinimized is the minimized window state.
StateMaximized: StateMaximized is the maximized window state.
StateFullscreen: StateFullscreen is the fullscreen window state.
KeyF1: KeyF1 is the F1 key, and the other function keys follow it up to KeyF12.
KeyLeft: KeyLeft is the left arrow key.
KeyRight: KeyRight is the right arrow key.
KeyUp: KeyUp is the up arrow key.
KeyDown: KeyDown is the down arrow key.
KeyPgUp: KeyPgUp is the page up key.
KeyPgDn: KeyPgDn is the page down key.
ModShift: ModShift is the shift modifier bit.
ModCtrl: ModCtrl is the ctrl modifier bit.
ModAlt: ModAlt is the alt modifier bit.
ModSuper: ModSuper is the super modifier bit, the windows or command key.
FmtBGRAPremul: FmtBGRAPremul is B G R A byte order in memory with premultiplied alpha, which is what goome uses inside.
FmtRGBAPremul: FmtRGBAPremul is R G B A byte order in memory with premultiplied alpha.
FmtBGRA: FmtBGRA is B G R A byte order in memory with straight alpha.
FmtRGBA: FmtRGBA is R G B A byte order in memory with straight alpha.
DirAuto: DirAuto sets each line to run the way its first strong letter goes.
DirLTR: DirLTR sets every line to run left to right.
DirRTL: DirRTL sets every line to run right to left.
IconArrowDown: IconArrowDown is the down arrow icon, used on combos, menubar menus and open headers and tree nodes.
IconArrowRight: IconArrowRight is the right arrow icon, used on closed headers, tree nodes and submenus.
IconArrowUp: IconArrowUp is the up arrow icon, used on open combos and menubar menus.
IconArrowLeft: IconArrowLeft is the left arrow icon, used on the left side of drag numbers.
IconCheck: IconCheck is the check mark icon, used on checkboxes and checked menu items.
IconRadioDot: IconRadioDot is the dot icon inside a selected radio button.
IconClose: IconClose is the close X icon, used on windows, modals and the app title bar.
IconMinimize: IconMinimize is the minimize button icon in the app title bar.
IconMaximize: IconMaximize is the maximize button icon in the app title bar.
IconRestore: IconRestore is the restore button icon in the app title bar.
IconResize: IconResize is the window resize grip icon.
IconSortUp: IconSortUp is the icon for a table column sorted ascending.
IconSortDown: IconSortDown is the icon for a table column sorted descending.
IconPlus: IconPlus is the plus icon on number widget buttons.
IconMinus: IconMinus is the minus icon on number widget buttons.
IconSliderKnob: IconSliderKnob is the slider knob icon, also used for the bars in the color picker.
IconToggleKnob: IconToggleKnob is the toggle knob icon.
IconCollapse: IconCollapse is the icon for the window collapse button.
IconExpand: IconExpand is the icon for the window expand button.
IconDragHandle: IconDragHandle is the split pane handle icon.
IconToast: IconToast is the mark icon drawn on toasts.
IconPicker: IconPicker is the color picker ring icon.
IconCount: IconCount is the number of icon slots, not an icon itself.
WinMove: WinMove lets the user drag the window by its title bar.
WinResize: WinResize adds a resize grip in the bottom right corner of the window.
WinCollapse: WinCollapse adds an arrow that folds the window to just its title.
WinNoTitle: WinNoTitle hides the window's title bar.
WinClose: WinClose adds a close X to the window that sets its open flag to false.
InputPassword: InputPassword draws the mask character per letter and makes copy and cut do nothing.
InputReadonly: InputReadonly blocks typing and pasting while still allowing select and copy.
InputNumber: InputNumber limits the input to digits, plus, minus and dot.
InputNoSelectOnFocus: InputNoSelectOnFocus puts the caret at the end when tabbing in instead of selecting everything.
InputEnterReturns: InputEnterReturns makes the input return 2 when enter is pressed, handy for login and search boxes.
AppTitlebar: AppTitlebar draws the app's own title bar with move, maximize and close handling.
AppMenubar: AppMenubar reserves room for a menu bar at the top of the app.
AppStatusbar: AppStatusbar adds a status bar at the bottom of the app.
AppNoPad: AppNoPad removes the padding around the app content.
EditReadonly: EditReadonly lets the text editor select and copy but not type.
EditLineNumbers: EditLineNumbers adds a gutter with line numbers to the text editor.
EditWrap: EditWrap wraps long lines in the text editor instead of scrolling sideways.
EditMono: EditMono makes the text editor use a monospace font.
TableSortable: TableSortable lets the user click a header to sort by it, and again to flip it.
TableResizable: TableResizable lets the user drag between headers to resize columns.
TableStripes: TableStripes makes every other table row a bit darker.
TableBorders: TableBorders draws lines between table cells.
StyleBg: StyleBg is the theme color for what sits behind everything, which app mode fills the window with.
StylePanel: StylePanel is the theme color for the window background color.
StyleBorder: StyleBorder is the theme color for window and widget outlines.
StyleText: StyleText is the theme color for the normal text color.
StyleTextDim: StyleTextDim is the theme color for the quieter text color.
StyleAccent: StyleAccent is the theme color for checked boxes, slider fill and the active tab.
StyleAccentText: StyleAccentText is the theme color for text drawn on top of the accent.
StyleHover: StyleHover is the theme color for the widget background color while hovered.
StyleActive: StyleActive is the theme color for the widget background color while pressed.
StyleInputBg: StyleInputBg is the theme color for the inside inputs and sliders.
StyleShadow: StyleShadow is the theme color for the window shadow color.
StyleRadius: StyleRadius is the theme number for the corner radius.
StylePad: StylePad is the theme number for the space inside windows.
StyleGap: StyleGap is the theme number for the space between widgets.
StyleBorderWidth: StyleBorderWidth is the theme number for the outline width.
StyleFontSize: StyleFontSize is the theme number for the text size.
StyleShadowBlur: StyleShadowBlur is the theme number for how soft shadows are.
StyleAnimMs: StyleAnimMs is the theme number for the animation length in milliseconds, with 0 meaning no animation.
StyleFocus: StyleFocus is the theme color for the focus ring and input glow color, with 0 meaning the accent.
StyleSelect: StyleSelect is the theme color for the selected text color, with 0 meaning a faded accent.
StyleCaret: StyleCaret is the theme color for the text caret color, with 0 meaning the accent.
StyleLink: StyleLink is the theme color for the link color, with 0 meaning the accent.
StyleBadge: StyleBadge is the theme color for the default badge color, with 0 meaning the accent.
StyleToast: StyleToast is the theme color for the toast background color, with 0 meaning the panel mixed with the hover color.
StyleTooltip: StyleTooltip is the theme color for the tooltip background color, with 0 meaning the background mixed with the hover color.
StyleDanger: StyleDanger is the theme color for the red close buttons, with 0 meaning the built in red.
StyleKnob: StyleKnob is the theme color for the slider and toggle knob color, with 0 meaning white.
StyleDim: StyleDim is the theme color for the drawn behind modals, with 0 meaning 0x73000000.
StyleCheckSize: StyleCheckSize is the theme number for the checkbox and radio box size.
StyleCheckRadius: StyleCheckRadius is the theme number for the checkbox corner radius.
StyleToggleW: StyleToggleW is the theme number for the toggle track width.
StyleToggleH: StyleToggleH is the theme number for the toggle track height.
StyleSliderH: StyleSliderH is the theme number for the slider height.
StyleSliderTrack: StyleSliderTrack is the theme number for the slider track thickness.
StyleKnobSize: StyleKnobSize is the theme number for the slider knob radius.
StyleScrollW: StyleScrollW is the theme number for the scrollbar width.
StyleScrollMin: StyleScrollMin is the theme number for the shortest a scrollbar thumb gets.
StyleItemH: StyleItemH is the theme number for the height of every widget row, with 0 meaning line height plus pad.
StyleMenuItemH: StyleMenuItemH is the theme number for the menu row height, with 0 meaning it comes from the font.
StyleTabH: StyleTabH is the theme number for the tab height, with 0 meaning it comes from the font.
StyleWinTitleH: StyleWinTitleH is the theme number for the window title bar height, with 0 meaning it comes from the font.
StyleAppTitleH: StyleAppTitleH is the theme number for the app title bar height, with 0 meaning it comes from the font.
StyleMenubarH: StyleMenubarH is the theme number for the app menu bar height, with 0 meaning it comes from the font.
StyleStatusbarH: StyleStatusbarH is the theme number for the app status bar height, with 0 meaning it comes from the font.
StyleFocusW: StyleFocusW is the theme number for the focus ring width.
StyleFocusGap: StyleFocusGap is the theme number for the space between a widget and its focus ring.
StyleSepW: StyleSepW is the theme number for the separator thickness.
StyleGrip: StyleGrip is the theme number for the window resize grip size.
StyleIndent: StyleIndent is the theme number for the tree indent.
StylePlotW: StylePlotW is the theme number for the plot line width.
StyleSpinner: StyleSpinner is the theme number for the default spinner size, with 0 meaning line height.
StyleCaretW: StyleCaretW is the theme number for the caret width, with 0 meaning thin and a wide value giving a block caret.
StyleWinMinW: StyleWinMinW is the theme number for the smallest width a window resizes to.
StyleWinMinH: StyleWinMinH is the theme number for the smallest height a window resizes to.
StylePopGap: StylePopGap is the theme number for the space between a combo or popup and what opened it.
StyleMenuGap: StyleMenuGap is the theme number for the offset of submenus.
StyleTipPadX: StyleTipPadX is the theme number for the horizontal padding inside tooltips.
StyleTipPadY: StyleTipPadY is the theme number for the vertical padding inside tooltips.
StyleTipX: StyleTipX is the theme number for the tooltip horizontal offset from the mouse.
StyleTipY: StyleTipY is the theme number for the tooltip vertical offset from the mouse.
StyleTipRadius: StyleTipRadius is the theme number for the tooltip corner radius.
StyleShadowX: StyleShadowX is the theme number for the shadow horizontal offset.
StyleShadowY: StyleShadowY is the theme number for the shadow vertical offset.
StyleAlign: StyleAlign is the theme setting for button and label text alignment, one of the Align constants.
StyleHeadingSize: StyleHeadingSize is the theme number for the heading text size, with 0 meaning 1.3 times the font size.
StyleSmallSize: StyleSmallSize is the theme number for the size of badges and statusbar text, with 0 meaning a bit under the font size.
StyleEase: StyleEase is the theme setting for the easing curve widgets use, one of the Ease constants.
StyleHoverMs: StyleHoverMs is the theme number for how long hover fades take in milliseconds, with below 0 following AnimMs.
StylePressMs: StylePressMs is the theme number for how long press fades take in milliseconds, with below 0 following AnimMs.
StylePopupMs: StylePopupMs is the theme number for how long popups and menus take to open in milliseconds, with below 0 following AnimMs.
StyleCollapseMs: StyleCollapseMs is the theme number for how long anything that folds open or shut takes in milliseconds, with below 0 following AnimMs.
StyleToastFadeMs: StyleToastFadeMs is the theme number for how long toasts take to fade out in milliseconds, with below 0 following AnimMs.
StyleCount: StyleCount is the number of style slots, not a style itself.
AlignAuto: AlignAuto lets each widget pick its own text alignment.
AlignLeft: AlignLeft aligns button and label text to the left.
AlignCenter: AlignCenter centers button and label text.
AlignRight: AlignRight aligns button and label text to the right.
EaseSmooth: EaseSmooth is the smoothstep easing curve the widgets use by default.
EaseLinear: EaseLinear is an easing curve with the same speed all the way.
EaseOut: EaseOut is an easing curve that starts fast and slows down at the end.
EaseInOut: EaseInOut is an easing curve that is slow, then fast, then slow.
EaseBack: EaseBack is an easing curve that goes a little past the target and comes back.
EaseCustom: EaseCustom is an easing curve that calls the function set in the UI config.
EaseIn: EaseIn is an easing curve that starts slow and ends fast.
EaseSpring: EaseSpring is an easing curve like a damped spring, about 16 percent over before it settles.
EaseBounce: EaseBounce is an easing curve that drops and bounces like a ball.
SkinButton: SkinButton is the skin kind for buttons.
SkinPanel: SkinPanel is the skin kind for windows.
SkinInput: SkinInput is the skin kind for text inputs, the text editor and drag numbers.
SkinCheckbox: SkinCheckbox is the skin kind for the checkbox box.
SkinRadio: SkinRadio is the skin kind for the radio circle.
SkinToggle: SkinToggle is the skin kind for the track behind the toggle knob.
SkinSliderTrack: SkinSliderTrack is the skin kind for the slider track.
SkinSliderFill: SkinSliderFill is the skin kind for the filled part of a slider.
SkinScrollbar: SkinScrollbar is the skin kind for the scrollbar thumb.
SkinTab: SkinTab is the skin kind for tabs.
SkinTitlebar: SkinTitlebar is the skin kind for window and app title bars.
SkinTooltip: SkinTooltip is the skin kind for tooltips.
SkinMenu: SkinMenu is the skin kind for menus and the open combo list.
SkinPopup: SkinPopup is the skin kind for popups, modals and the color picker.
SkinCount: SkinCount is the number of skin kinds, not a kind itself.
ItemDragX: ItemDragX makes a custom item draggable, sideways only when used alone.
ItemDragY: ItemDragY makes a custom item draggable, up and down only when used alone. With ItemDragX it drags freely.
ItemFocusable: ItemFocusable gives a custom item tab focus and raw key input.
ItemNoHit: ItemNoHit makes a custom item never hovered or pressed, for backgrounds you put other widgets on.
ItemRepeat: ItemRepeat makes a custom item's clicked fire on the press and keep firing while held.
PresetDark: PresetDark is the dark theme preset.
PresetLight: PresetLight is the light theme preset.
PresetMidnight: PresetMidnight is the midnight theme preset.
PresetPaper: PresetPaper is the paper theme preset.
PresetMint: PresetMint is the mint theme preset.
PresetHighContrast: PresetHighContrast is the high contrast theme preset.
PresetRose: PresetRose is the rose theme preset.
PresetCount: PresetCount is the number of theme presets, not a preset itself.
ActCopy: ActCopy is the copy action in the UI key map.
ActCut: ActCut is the cut action in the UI key map.
ActPaste: ActPaste is the paste action in the UI key map.
ActUndo: ActUndo is the undo action in the UI key map.
ActRedo: ActRedo is the redo action in the UI key map.
ActSelectAll: ActSelectAll is the select all action in the UI key map.
ActWordLeft: ActWordLeft is the move one word left action in the UI key map.
ActWordRight: ActWordRight is the move one word right action in the UI key map.
ActDelWordLeft: ActDelWordLeft is the delete word to the left action in the UI key map.
ActDelWordRight: ActDelWordRight is the delete word to the right action in the UI key map.
ActDocStart: ActDocStart is the jump to the start of the text action in the UI key map.
ActDocEnd: ActDocEnd is the jump to the end of the text action in the UI key map.
ActCount: ActCount is the number of key map actions, not an action itself.
CurButton: CurButton is the UI cursor kind used over buttons.
CurInput: CurInput is the UI cursor kind used over text inputs.
CurLink: CurLink is the UI cursor kind used over links.
CurDragValue: CurDragValue is the UI cursor kind used over drag number widgets.
CurSplitX: CurSplitX is the UI cursor kind used over a vertical split handle.
CurSplitY: CurSplitY is the UI cursor kind used over a horizontal split handle.
CurGrip: CurGrip is the UI cursor kind used over the window resize grip.
CurColumn: CurColumn is the UI cursor kind used over table column borders.
CurDragDrop: CurDragDrop is the UI cursor kind used during a drag and drop.
CurCustomX: CurCustomX is the UI cursor kind used over custom widgets that drag sideways.
CurCustomY: CurCustomY is the UI cursor kind used over custom widgets that drag up and down.
CurCustomXy: CurCustomXy is the UI cursor kind used over custom widgets that drag freely.
CurCount: CurCount is the number of UI cursor kinds, not a kind itself.
RoleNone: RoleNone is the accessibility role for a node with no role.
RoleWindow: RoleWindow is the accessibility role for a window.
RoleButton: RoleButton is the accessibility role for a button.
RoleCheckbox: RoleCheckbox is the accessibility role for a checkbox.
RoleRadio: RoleRadio is the accessibility role for a radio button.
RoleSlider: RoleSlider is the accessibility role for a slider.
RoleText: RoleText is the accessibility role for plain text.
RoleInput: RoleInput is the accessibility role for a text input.
RoleCombo: RoleCombo is the accessibility role for a combo box.
RoleList: RoleList is the accessibility role for a list.
RoleItem: RoleItem is the accessibility role for a list item.
RoleTab: RoleTab is the accessibility role for a tab.
RoleMenu: RoleMenu is the accessibility role for a menu.
RoleMenuItem: RoleMenuItem is the accessibility role for a menu item.
RoleTable: RoleTable is the accessibility role for a table.
RoleTree: RoleTree is the accessibility role for a tree.
RoleProgress: RoleProgress is the accessibility role for a progress bar.
RoleImage: RoleImage is the accessibility role for an image.
RoleGroup: RoleGroup is the accessibility role for a group of widgets.
RoleDialog: RoleDialog is the accessibility role for a dialog.
A11yFocused: A11yFocused is set on an accessibility node that has keyboard focus.
A11yChecked: A11yChecked is set on an accessibility node that is checked.
A11yDisabled: A11yDisabled is set on an accessibility node that is disabled.
A11yExpanded: A11yExpanded is set on an accessibility node that is expanded.
A11ySelected: A11ySelected is set on an accessibility node that is selected.
